unmapped: Rewards are D-dimensional vectors in [0,1]^D; regret is Pareto regret with respect to the super Pareto front
Actions are nonnegative real weight vectors over N base arms (weighted linear combination of arm reward vectors), at most L nonzero entries
The learner knows the number of objectives D (used in the confidence width)
settings.definition_quote: In COMO-MAB, there exists $N$ arms ... The $D$-dimensional random reward vector of arm $i$ at time step $t$ ... is drawn from an unknown distribution with finite support, which is assumed to be the unit hypercube $[0,1]^D$ ... The $D$-dimensional reward vector of action $\vec{a}$ in time step $t$ is given by $\vec{R}_{\vec{a}}(t) = \sum_{i=1}^n a_i \vec{X}_i(t)$ ... it observes the reward vectors of the arms in ${\cal N}_{\text{nz}}(\vec{a}(t))$.

symbols.a_max: maximum action weight max_a max_q a_q

conditions: Delta_min and Delta_max are Pareto suboptimality gaps (distance to the super Pareto front)

source.label: thm:mainregret
source.quote: When run with $C_{i}(t) = \sqrt{\frac{(L+1)\log{((t-1)\sqrt[4]{D})}}{m_{i}(t)}}$ the expected regret of COMO-UCB is bounded by \mathbb{E} [\mathrm{Reg}(T)] \leq \Delta_{\max}\Big( \frac{4a^2_{\max}NL^2(L+1)\log(T\sqrt[4]{D})}{\Delta_{\min}^2} + N + \frac{\pi^2}{3}NL \Big) where $a_{\max} = \max_{\vec{a} \in \mathcal{A}} \{ \max_q a_q \}$.

results.notes: Pareto regret E[sum_t Delta_{a(t)}]; quantity 'other' since gap is the multi-objective PSG. L mapped to m. Corollaries 2 and 3 (recommender, routing) are the same expression with a_max=1, D=2, L=K or path length.

bound.expression_latex: \Delta_{\max}\Big( \frac{4 M^3 Q H (M+1)\log(T\sqrt[4]{2})}{\Delta_{\min}^2} + MQH + \frac{\pi^2}{3} M^2 Q H \Big)

conditions: multi-user multi-objective communication problem: N = MQH arms, actions are user-channel-rate matchings, D = 2 objectives

source.quote: For the multi-user multi-objective communication problem, the expected regret of COMO-UCB run with the same $C_i(t)$ value in Theorem \ref{thm:mainregret} is bounded by $\mathbb{E} [\mathrm{Reg}(T)] \leq \Delta_{\max}\Big( \frac{4 M^3 Q H (M+1)\log(T\sqrt[4]{2})}{\Delta_{\min}^2} + MQH + \frac{\pi^2}{3} M^2 Q H \Big)$.

results.notes: Specialization of Theorem 1 with a_max=1, N=MQH, L=M, D=2.

source.quote: When run with $$C_{i}(t) = \sqrt{\frac{2\Big(1+2\log \big( D|\mathcal{A}|T \big)\Big)}{m_{i}(t)}},$$ the expected regret of COMO-UCB is bounded by \mathbb{E} [\mathrm{Reg}(T)] \leq 4|\mathcal{A}|L\sqrt{T} \sqrt{2(1+2\log(D|\mathcal{A}|T))} + \Delta_{max}

results.notes: Theorem is inside \ifodd 2 ... \fi, which in LaTeX evaluates false, so it may not be printed despite the annotation. Requires knowledge of T, |A|, D.
